Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000364": As of 2025-04-24, the Cinder team reported that the feature-flags service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.  (about: Cinder, feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000321": As of 2025-04-07, the Ember team reported that the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout.  (about: notifier, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000298" [constraint]: For anything Ember-related, page Oskar.  (about: Ember team, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000286": On 2025-03-26 the Dune team observed that the notification service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Dune team, notification service)
- memory_id "1000259": The billing API is owned by the Ember team as of 2025-03-07.  (about: billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000253": The ledger service relies on the auth gateway for service tokens, so if the auth gateway is down, the ledger service is down.  (about: ledger service, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000246": The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Ember team as of 2025-03-03.  (about: webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000242": As of 2025-03-03, the pager for the webhook dispatcher rings the Ember team instead of the Boreal team.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000227": On 2025-02-21 the Boreal team noticed that the ledger service's memory use had grown steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000193": The webhook dispatcher relies on the bus for outbound events, so if the bus is down the webhook dispatcher is down.  (about: the bus, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000188": The notifier relies on the bus for delivery events, so if the bus is down the notifier is down.  (about: the bus, notifier)
- memory_id "1000183": The job scheduler depends on the feature-flags service for per-job kill switches.  (about: feature-flags, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000180" [decision]: The Ember team does pairing on every production change.  (about: Ember team)
- memory_id "1000177" [constraint]: Deploys to the job scheduler happen on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC and at no other time.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000165": During incident INC-2025-004, the notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000160" [constraint]: The ledger service must stay on Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes.  (about: ledger service, Postgres 14)
- memory_id "1000136": The job scheduler is owned by the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000109" [constraint]: The ledger service only ships on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000105": Oskar takes the first on-call shift of the year for the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000043": The feature-flags service is owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, feature-flags)
Existing entity names: Cinder, feature-flags, notifier, Ember team, Oskar, Dune team, notification service, billing API, ledger service, auth gateway, webhook dispatcher, Boreal team, the bus, job scheduler, INC-2025-004, Postgres 14, Atlas team

The note:

[2025-04-29] standup/ember/2025-04-29: The scheduler still relies on the feature flag service; keep that in mind for the maintenance.
